create_Model_from_OmegaConf: create a Model instance from an OmegaConf YAML config with experiment, environment, agent, and training settings
run_model_train: run the Model train method to execute a PPO reinforcement learning training loop on a CompilerGym environment
run_model_test: run the Model test method to evaluate a trained RL agent on benchmark datasets
verify_training_checkpoints: verify that training output directories, JSON metadata files, and checkpoint files were created after training
configure_PPOTrainer_agent: configure a PPOTrainer agent with learning rate, fcnet hidden layers, activation, and batch size parameters
